entries.title: Psalms 115:1
segments: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name give glory, for Your mercy [and] for Your truth's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 115:2
segments: Why should the nations say, Where now [is] their God?

entries.title: Psalms 115:3
segments: But our God [is] in Heaven; He has done whatever He has pleased.

entries.title: Psalms 115:4
segments: Their idols [are] silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 115:5
segments: They [have] mouths, but they do not speak; they [have] eyes, but they do not see;

entries.title: Psalms 115:6
segments: they [have] ears, but they do not hear; they [have] noses, but they do not smell;

entries.title: Psalms 115:7
segments: they have hands, but they do not handle; they have feet, but they do not walk; they do not mutter through their throat.

entries.title: Psalms 115:8
segments: The ones who make them are like them, [and] everyone who trusts in them.

entries.title: Psalms 115:9
segments: O Israel, trust in the LORD; He [is] their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:10
segments: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; He [is] their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:11
segments: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; He [is] their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:12
segments: The LORD has been mindful of us; He will bless [us]; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

entries.title: Psalms 115:13
segments: He will bless those who fear the LORD, [both] small and great.

entries.title: Psalms 115:14
segments: The LORD shall add on to you, even on you and on your sons.

entries.title: Psalms 115:15
segments: You [are] blessed of the LORD who made the heavens and the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 115:16
segments: The heavens, [even] the heavens, [are] the LORD's; but the earth He has given to the sons of men.

entries.title: Psalms 115:17
segments: The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do any who go down into silence.

entries.title: Psalms 115:18
segments: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and forevermore. Praise the LORD!
